Interface Messenger

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractMessenger
public interface Messenger extends AutoCloseable
Messenger interface to send messages across channels using a Broker.

This interface is intended to be implemented by classes that want to provide messaging capabilities using a broker, allowing for sending messages to specific channels and managing subscriptions to those channels.

      @Nullable @Nullable MessageBroker subscribe(@NotNull @NotNull MessageBroker broker)
      Subscribe to provided message channel.

    • send

      void send(@NotNull @NotNull String channel, @Nullable @Nullable Object... lines) throws IOException
      Send multi-line message to provided channel name.

      Take in count this method accept any Object as message lines, but everything will be converted to String.
      If any object is null or "null" it will be sent as null object, and any consumer will get a null object as well.
      Parameters:
      channel - the channel name to send the message
      lines - the message lines
      Throws:
      IOException - if any I/O error occurs
      IllegalStateException - if the messenger is not enabled or the channel doesn't exist
